name: Quick Price Editor for WooCommerce
author: Hadi Shiri

sections.description:
A powerful yet simple price editor for WooCommerce, built for store owners who need to update product prices quickly and safely.

Quick Price Editor for WooCommerce gives you full control over your store’s pricing. Whether you want to apply a percentage increase to a selected group of products, adjust sale prices only, or round prices to the nearest ten, this plugin makes it easy – with a live preview before you commit any change.

Designed with usability and safety in mind, the plugin shows up to 50 parent products at a time, lets you filter by category, tag, or stock status, and includes a bulk adjustment tool that works on selected rows. All changes are saved only after you confirm, so you never accidentally update the wrong prices.

Why choose Quick Price Editor?

  • Safe & secure – every change requires a confirmation, no automatic updates.
  • Preview before applying – see the new prices instantly before saving.
  • Bulk adjustment – increase or decrease prices by percentage on regular, sale, or both prices.
  • Smart rounding – round up, down, or normally to the nearest 1, 10, 100, or 1000.
  • Works with simple and variable products – manage variations efficiently.
  • Filter products by category, tag, and stock status to target exactly the products you need.
  • Select and save only the rows you want – no need to reload the page.

Perfect for:
– Store owners who need to apply seasonal discounts or price increases.
– Developers who want a reliable tool for bulk price updates.
– Anyone who needs to quickly correct pricing after a tax or exchange rate change.

Key Features:

✅ Safe editing – no automatic saving; you always confirm changes.
✅ Live preview – see the effect of any adjustment before saving.
✅ Bulk percentage adjustments – increase or decrease by any percentage (0.01 – 1000%).
✅ Apply to regular, sale, or both prices – choose exactly what to adjust.
✅ Rounding settings – choose rounding method (ceil/round/floor) and precision (1, 10, 100, 1000).
✅ Filter products – by category, tag, and stock status.
✅ Works with simple and variable products – supports all product types.
✅ Lightweight & fast – optimised for performance.
✅ Fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Why we built this plugin

Managing prices in a WooCommerce store can be tedious and error‑prone. We created Quick Price Editor to give store owners a professional, intuitive tool that eliminates guesswork and reduces the risk of mistakes. Whether you’re running a small shop or a large online store, this plugin helps you stay in control of your pricing strategy.

Get the most out of your WooCommerce store

With Quick Price Editor, you can quickly adapt to market changes, run promotions, or correct pricing errors – all from a single, clean interface. It’s the ideal companion for any WooCommerce store that needs flexible, on‑the‑fly price management.

Support and feedback

We’re committed to making this plugin better with each update. If you have ideas, questions, or run into any issues, please contact us at c.hadi.shiri@gmail.com.

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Quick Price Editor for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  5. Navigate to WooMaster → Quick Price Editor to start editing prices.

Alternatively, upload the plugin ZIP file manually via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, it fully supports variable products and displays each variation as a separate row. You can also use the “Use same prices for all variations” option to quickly apply the same price across all variations of a product.[reference:3]

Will changes be applied immediately?

No. All changes are saved only after you click the Save selected rows button. You can also use the Preview button to see the new prices before committing.[reference:4]

Can I undo a change?

The plugin does not include an undo feature, but you can always manually revert the prices using the editor again. Always double‑check the preview before saving.

Does it support rounding?

Yes. You can round prices using three methods (ceil, round, floor) and choose a precision of 1, 10, 100, or 1000. Settings are available under the “Rounding settings” section on the plugin page.[reference:5]

Can I filter products by stock status?

Yes, you can filter by In Stock or Out of Stock, as well as by category and tags.[reference:6]

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions?

Yes, we regularly test with the latest versions. It also declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables).[reference:7]

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads its assets on its own admin page. It does not affect your frontend performance.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

Release date: July 14, 2026
* Major update: complete code refactor for better performance and security.
* Added live preview for individual rows and bulk adjustments.
* New rounding options (ceil, round, floor) with precision choices.
* Introduced nonce and capability checks for secure AJAX operations.
* Improved interface with sticky save button and select‑all functionality.
* Better support for variable products with “sync prices” toggle.
* Full compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS.
* Translations ready (but now handled automatically by WordPress).

2.0.0

Release date: March 2025
* Initial public release.
* Basic price editing with filters and bulk adjustments.
* Support for simple products only.
